description: This file contains CMake functions and macro definitions for removing the first element from a list and returning it. It includes a function 'list_pop_front' and a macro 'list_pop_front', both implementing similar logic with slight differences, aimed at list manipulation within CMake build scripts.

methods.name: list_pop_front
methods.description: Removes the first element of a list and returns it. Implements logic for empty list, single-element list, and multi-element list to modify the list in place and output the removed element.
